recipe.build:
sed -r '/abi \{/,/}/ { s/include\(.*\)/include("arm64-v8a")/ ; s/isUniversalApk = true/isUniversalApk = false/ }' -i app/build.gradle.kts
chmod +x gradlew
PROF_FILE=app/build/intermediates/binary_art_profile/fossRelease/compileFossReleaseArtProfile/baseline.prof
PROF_SHA1=6513b40920018c2b8344834c862d4fa28db1652d
for _ in {1..10}; do
./gradlew clean assembleFossRelease --no-build-cache --no-configuration-cache --no-daemon
find . -name baseline.prof
if [ "$( sha1sum "$PROF_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1 )" = "$PROF_SHA1" ]; then
break
fi
done
mv app/build/outputs/apk/foss/release/image-toolbox-*-foss-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
